content.thinking: `ImageRep::nexthops` is `std::vector<nexthop_t>` (uint64) while `ImageData::nexthops` is `std::vector<uint32_t>`. Change ImageRep::nexthops to std::vector<uint32_t> and the lookup returns cast. Or copy element-wise. Simplest: make ImageRep::nexthops std::vector<uint32_t>. Lookup returns nexthop_t → implicit conversion fine.

arguments.command: cd /workspace/src && sed -i 's/    std::vector<nexthop_t> nexthops;/    std::vector<uint32_t> nexthops;/' image.hpp && cd /workspace && python3 build.py
